Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class BigMap<K,V>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.BigMap<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the type of unique key associated with values in this map
V - the type of element associated with the keys
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Entry<K,V>>
Direct Known Subclasses:
BigHashMap, BigNumberedMap
public abstract class BigMap<K,V> extends Object implements Iterable<Entry<K,V>>
A custom implementation of a map, which associates unique keys with values, which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY entries, and which uses long integers to measure its size().
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
